name: TickLabels
description: Represents the tick-mark labels associated with tick marks on a chart axis.
remarks: This object is not a collection. There is no object that represents a single tick-mark label; you must return all the tick-mark labels as a unit. Tick-mark label text for the category axis comes from the name of the associated category in the chart. The default tick-mark label text for the category axis is the number that indicates the position of the category relative to the left end of this axis. To change the number of unlabeled tick marks between tick-mark labels, you must change the TickLabelSpacing property for the category axis. Tick-mark label text for the value axis is calculated based on the MajorUnit, MinimumScale, and MaximumScale properties of the value axis. To change the tick-mark label text for the value axis, you must change the values of these properties.
example:
With ActiveDocument.InlineShapes(1)

    If .HasChart Then

        .Chart.Axes(xlValue).TickLabels.NumberFormat = "0.00"

    End If

End With

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent for the specified object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: Font
properties.description: Returns the font of the specified object. Read-only ChartFont.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns the name of the object. Read-only String.

properties.name: NumberFormat
properties.description: Returns or sets the format code for the object. Read/write String.

properties.name: NumberFormatLinked
properties.description: True if the number format is linked to the cells (so that the number format changes in the labels when it changes in the cells). Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: NumberFormatLocal
properties.description: Returns or sets the format code for the object as a string in the language of the user. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Orientation
properties.description: Returns or sets the text orientation. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Depth
properties.description: Returns the number of levels of category tick labels. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Offset
properties.description: Returns or sets the distance between the levels of labels, and the distance between the first level and the axis line. Read/write Long.

properties.name: MultiLevel
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether an axis is multilevel. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: Returns the line, fill, and effect formatting for the object. Read-only ChartFormat.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft PowerPoint application. When used with an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return the application of that object). Read-only.

properties.name: Alignment
properties.description: Returns or sets the alignment for the specified phonetic text or tick label. Read/write Long.

properties.name: ReadingOrder
properties.description: Returns or sets an XlReadingOrder constant that represents the reading order for the specified object. Read/write Long.
